ESubpackages

EPackage: common

  • NS URI: https://gitlab.com/ucof/ucof.de/model/v001/ucof/common
  • NS Prefix: de.ucof.model.common
  • Documentation: Container, including commonly used Types, Enums and Data-Definitions

ESubpackages

EPackage: enums

  • NS URI: https://gitlab.com/ucof/ucof.de/model/v001/ucof/common/enums
  • NS Prefix: de.ucof.model.common.enums
  • Documentation: Container, including commonly used Enums
EClassifiers
booleanType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Definition for boolen type with true/false. Has "NotSet" as default for deterministic behaviour
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = true
  • 2 = false
TargetDataType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Target Data Type for transformations. Can be extended with more potential data types.
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = String
  • 2 = UInt8
MemoryAccessType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Memory Acces Type, primarily used for A653 Operating Systems, can be employed for all memory acces options
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = Read
  • 2 = ReadWrite
  • 3 = Write
MemoryType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Definition for Memory Types primarily used for A653 operating systems
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = Volatile
  • 2 = NonVolatile
PortDirectionType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Port Direction setting with bidirectional setting possible (InOut) for e.g., A825/CAN
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = In
  • 2 = Out
  • 3 = InOut
SingleDirectionType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Port Direction setting with bidirectional setting impossible
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = In
  • 2 = Out
YesNoType (Enum)
  • Documentation: "Yes" or "No" setting, with "NotSet" as default
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = No
  • 2 = Yes
SDITypes (Enum)
  • Name: SDITypes
  • Documentation: SDI Types for ARINC429 interface setting
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = ZERO
  • 2 = ONE
  • 3 = TWO
  • 4 = THREE
ImplementationType (Enum)
  • Documentation: Implementation type for devices, virtual is simulation, hardware is an emulation or real hardware
  • 0 = NotSet
  • 1 = Virtual
  • 2 = Hardware

EPackage: edata

  • NS URI: https://gitlab.com/ucof/ucof.de/model/v001/ucof/common/edata
  • NS Prefix: de.ucof.model.common.edata
  • Documentation: Container, includes commonly used data definitions
EClassifiers
DecOrHexValueType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Documentation: A653: Allows hex and decimal numbers. Hex start 0x
  • Name: DEC_OR_HEX_VALUE_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: ([+-]{0,1}[0-9]+|[+-]{0,1}0x[0-9a-fA-F]+)?
HexAddressType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Name: HexAddressType
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: 0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+|[0-9]+
IdentifierValueType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Documentation: A653/RCE/RPC: Restricts identifiers to hex or decimal numbers.
  • Name: IDENTIFIER_VALUE_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: [+-]{0,1}[0-9]+|[+-]{0,1}0x[0-9a-fA-F]+
UUIDType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Documentation: for UUIDs
  • Name: UUID_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: [0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}
IPAddressType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Name: IP_ADDRESS_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: (([^.])|([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3})?
NameType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Documentation: A653: A 1..30 character string.
  • Name: NAME_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • MinLength: 1
  • MaxLength: 30
PortType (Instance Class: java.lang.Integer)
  • Name: PORT_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#int:Object
  • MinInclusive: 0
  • MaxInclusive: 65535
PositiveIntType (Instance Class: java.lang.Integer)
  • Name: POSITIVE_INTEGER_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#int:Object
  • MinInclusive: 0
MACAddressType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Name: MAC_ADDRESS_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: [0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}
EtherType (Instance Class: java.lang.String)
  • Name: ETHER_TYPE
  • BaseType: http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2003/XMLType#string
  • Pattern: 0x[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}
